comment: Differences between the committed snapshots and a deployment's OpenAPI that are deliberate. Each is explained in contracts/README.md. Entries match an operation name (or "*") plus an exact `difference` or a `pattern` regex. Keep this list small: it is the thing that stops check-drift.mjs from being read.

deliberate.reason: The trading Exchange enum is restored to the actual domain (AGARA/POLYMARKET). Environment documentation projects it to AGARA even on shared multi-exchange DTOs, so a single-exchange deployment always looks narrower.

Across and CCTP batch operations require server signing. The snapshot keeps their variants so the types stay complete, and the presigned helpers reject them locally; a deployment without the bridge omits them.

The three deposit paths are source-backed additions (apps/router/src/handlers/portfolio.rs, crates/service/src/portfolio.rs); the environment-projected document omits mounted multi-exchange paths even though the routes respond.
AGARA split/merge acceptance status is PENDING (apps/router/src/handlers.rs); the projected document does not carry the enum.
